sources.title: Determinantal Hypersurfaces
sources.locator: Corollary 6.4, printed pp.52-53, PDF pages 14-15 (one-based); Proposition 6.2 supplies the preceding construction. Corollary 6.5 treats the non-algebraically-closed case.
sources.short_verbatim_excerpt: Assume that k is algebraically closed. A smooth cubic surface can be defined by an equation det M = 0
sources.paraphrase: Corollary 6.4 specifies a three by three matrix of linear forms, and classifies 72 representations up to left and right equivalence. The statement concerns smooth surfaces over an algebraically closed field. It is not a claim that every singular cubic has an exact such representation.
